paragraphs.notes: Markush enumeration table, compound numbers 314 to 340, continued from the preceding page and continuing onto the next: the page carries no Tabelle caption and no scaffold drawing, only the shaded column header row and the rows. Subscripts and superscripts are printed as true sub/superscripts (R7a, R7b, R12, R1 with superscript labels; MeSO2, EtSO2, PrSO2, PhSO2, 4-Me-PhSO2, PhC(O)CH2 with subscript digits); they are flattened to plain text here. The cells are chemical symbols, not German prose, so zh and en are the same string. The L column is CHMe for every row on this page. The R1 column changes value mid-table: rows 314 to 317 are O-c-Pentyl, rows 318 to 340 are O-c-Bu. Scan artifacts, not characters: a dark ink speck sits immediately above the O of O-c-Pentyl in row 315, a small speck sits in the Nr. cell of row 334 to the right of the number, and a short stray horizontal rule crosses the R7b column between rows 334 and 335. The R12 cell of row 337 is printed a little further right than the cells above and below it; the text is the same PhSO2. No abbreviation key is printed on this page, so Bz, Pr, c-Bu and c-Pentyl are transcribed as printed and not expanded.
